subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the open dirty fork PR that declares this issue fixed, or replace it with a fresh target-repo Feishu fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the only exact candidate is outside the target repository, unmerged, dirty, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Replace or repair the candidate
options.body: Use the open fork PR as source context, but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the mention-gating and root-routing safety concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu bug without creating another repair lane until a maintainer can own the channel fix.

recommendation.title: Replace or repair the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as source context, but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for deciding the safe dropped-mention shape.
